name: REN - DEV - WF-02B - Campaign Batch Sender_quicklink

parameters.jsCode:
const CLAIM_SQL = "WITH requested AS (
  SELECT
    $1::uuid AS dispatch_id,
    coalesce($2::timestamptz, now()) AS send_at,
    nullif(lower(btrim($3::text)), '') AS simulate_http_status,
    coalesce($4::boolean, false) AS respond_to_webhook,
    coalesce($5::boolean, false) AS real_send
), claim_clock AS (
  SELECT
    clock_timestamp() AS claimed_at,
    date_trunc('minute', clock_timestamp()) AS window_started_at
), send_guard AS (
  SELECT renovation_dev.is_automatic_send_allowed((SELECT send_at FROM requested)) AS allowed
), expired_leases AS (
  UPDATE renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatches dispatch
     SET status = CASE
           WHEN dispatch.worker_attempt_count >= 4 THEN 'failed'::renovation_dev.dispatch_status
           ELSE 'queued'::renovation_dev.dispatch_status
         END,
         process_after = CASE dispatch.worker_attempt_count
           WHEN 1 THEN (SELECT claimed_at FROM claim_clock) + interval '30 seconds'
           WHEN 2 THEN (SELECT claimed_at FROM claim_clock) + interval '120 seconds'
           WHEN 3 THEN (SELECT claimed_at FROM claim_clock) + interval '300 seconds'
           ELSE dispatch.process_after
         END,
         next_attempt_at = CASE dispatch.worker_attempt_count
           WHEN 1 THEN (SELECT claimed_at FROM claim_clock) + interval '30 seconds'
           WHEN 2 THEN (SELECT claimed_at FROM claim_clock) + interval '120 seconds'
           WHEN 3 THEN (SELECT claimed_at FROM claim_clock) + interval '300 seconds'
           ELSE NULL
         END,
         completed_at = CASE
           WHEN dispatch.worker_attempt_count >= 4 THEN (SELECT claimed_at FROM claim_clock)
           ELSE NULL
         END,
         lease_token = NULL,
         leased_at = NULL,
         lease_expires_at = NULL,
         last_error = 'worker_lease_expired'
   WHERE dispatch.status = 'running'
     AND dispatch.lease_expires_at <= (SELECT claimed_at FROM claim_clock)
  RETURNING dispatch.id, dispatch.client_id, dispatch.status
), expired_final_items AS (
  UPDATE renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items item
     SET status = 'failed'::renovation_dev.delivery_status,
         reject_reason = 'SEND_FAILED',
         last_error = 'worker_lease_expired',
         attempt_count = 3
    FROM expired_leases expired
   WHERE expired.status = 'failed'
     AND item.dispatch_id = expired.id
      AND item.status = 'pending'
  RETURNING item.id
), rate_limited_clients AS (
  SELECT claim_window_row.client_id
    FROM renovation_dev.provider_dispatch_claim_windows claim_window_row, claim_clock
   WHERE claim_window_row.window_started_at = claim_clock.window_started_at
     AND claim_window_row.claim_count >= 10
), candidate AS (
  SELECT dispatch.id, dispatch.client_id
    FROM renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatches dispatch
    CROSS JOIN requested
    CROSS JOIN claim_clock
   WHERE dispatch.status = 'queued'
      AND dispatch.process_after <= claim_clock.claimed_at
      AND (requested.dispatch_id IS NULL OR dispatch.id = requested.dispatch_id)
      AND (requested.dispatch_id IS NOT NULL OR dispatch.dev_simulate_http_status IS NULL)
      AND (requested.dispatch_id IS NOT NULL OR dispatch.last_error IS DISTINCT FROM 'dev_deferred_pending')
      AND (
        requested.real_send
        OR NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
            FROM renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items real_item
           WHERE real_item.dispatch_id = dispatch.id
             AND real_item.status = 'pending'
             AND real_item.metadata->>'realSendMode' = 'real'
        )
      )
     AND (SELECT allowed FROM send_guard)
     AND NOT EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
         FROM expired_leases expired
        WHERE expired.client_id = dispatch.client_id
     )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatches active
        WHERE active.client_id = dispatch.client_id
          AND active.status = 'running'
           AND active.lease_expires_at > claim_clock.claimed_at
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM rate_limited_clients limited
         WHERE limited.client_id = dispatch.client_id
      )
      AND pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(dispatch.client_id, 0))
   ORDER BY
     CASE WHEN dispatch.id = requested.dispatch_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
     dispatch.process_after,
     dispatch.requested_at,
     dispatch.id
   LIMIT 1
   FOR UPDATE OF dispatch SKIP LOCKED
), claim_window AS (
  INSERT INTO renovation_dev.provider_dispatch_claim_windows (
    client_id, window_started_at, claim_count
  )
  SELECT candidate.client_id, claim_clock.window_started_at, 1
    FROM candidate, claim_clock
  ON CONFLICT (client_id, window_started_at) DO UPDATE
    SET claim_count = renovation_dev.provider_dispatch_claim_windows.claim_count + 1,
        updated_at = now()
  WHERE renovation_dev.provider_dispatch_claim_windows.claim_count < 10
  RETURNING client_id, window_started_at, claim_count
), claimed AS (
  UPDATE renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatches dispatch
     SET status = 'running'::renovation_dev.dispatch_status,
         worker_attempt_count = dispatch.worker_attempt_count + 1,
         started_at = coalesce(dispatch.started_at, (SELECT claimed_at FROM claim_clock)),
         next_attempt_at = NULL,
          lease_token = gen_random_uuid(),
          leased_at = (SELECT claimed_at FROM claim_clock),
          lease_expires_at = (SELECT claimed_at FROM claim_clock) + interval '60 seconds',
          dev_simulate_http_status = coalesce(requested.simulate_http_status, dispatch.dev_simulate_http_status)
    FROM candidate, claim_window, requested
   WHERE dispatch.id = candidate.id
     AND claim_window.client_id = candidate.client_id
  RETURNING dispatch.*
), marked_real_items AS (
  UPDATE renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items item
     SET metadata = item.metadata || jsonb_build_object('realSendMode', 'real'),
         updated_at = now()
    FROM claimed, requested
   WHERE item.dispatch_id = claimed.id
     AND item.status = 'pending'
     AND requested.real_send
  RETURNING item.id
), selected_dispatch AS (
  SELECT * FROM claimed
  UNION ALL
  SELECT dispatch.*
    FROM renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatches dispatch, requested
   WHERE dispatch.id = requested.dispatch_id
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claimed)
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  selected_dispatch.id::text AS job_id,
  selected_dispatch.sf_dispatch_id,
  (claimed.id IS NOT NULL) AS claimed,
  (SELECT allowed FROM send_guard) AS allowed_to_send,
  CASE
    WHEN claimed.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'claimed'
    WHEN NOT (SELECT allowed FROM send_guard) THEN 'outside_business_hours'
    WHEN selected_dispatch.id IS NOT NULL AND selected_dispatch.status = 'running' THEN 'client_busy'
    WHEN selected_dispatch.id IS NOT NULL AND selected_dispatch.process_after > (SELECT claimed_at FROM claim_clock) THEN 'not_due'
    WHEN selected_dispatch.id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM rate_limited_clients limited
       WHERE limited.client_id = selected_dispatch.client_id
    ) THEN 'client_rate_limited'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidate) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claim_window) THEN 'claim_race_lost'
    ELSE 'no_due_dispatch'
  END AS outcome,
  selected_dispatch.status::text AS dispatch_status,
  selected_dispatch.worker_attempt_count AS attempt_count,
  selected_dispatch.process_after,
  selected_dispatch.next_attempt_at,
  selected_dispatch.lease_token::text,
  selected_dispatch.lease_expires_at,
  coalesce(requested.simulate_http_status, selected_dispatch.dev_simulate_http_status) AS simulate_http_status,
  requested.respond_to_webhook,
  CASE
    WHEN requested.real_send OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marked_real_items) THEN 'real'
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items real_item
       WHERE real_item.dispatch_id = selected_dispatch.id
         AND real_item.status = 'pending'
         AND real_item.metadata->>'realSendMode' = 'real'
    ) THEN 'real'
    ELSE 'dry_run'
  END AS send_mode,
  coalesce(10 - claim_window.claim_count, 0) AS rate_remaining,
  0::integer AS sent_count,
  0::integer AS failed_count,
  coalesce((
    SELECT count(*)::integer
      FROM renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items item
     WHERE item.dispatch_id = selected_dispatch.id
       AND item.status = 'pending'
  ), 0) AS pending_count
FROM requested
LEFT JOIN selected_dispatch ON true
LEFT JOIN claimed ON claimed.id = selected_dispatch.id
LEFT JOIN claim_window ON claim_window.client_id = selected_dispatch.client_id;
";
function env(name, fallback = '') { try { return $env[name] || fallback; } catch (e) { return fallback; } }

// Fail closed: the poller is disabled until real provider delivery is integrated.
if (String(env('RENOV_DEV_DRY_RUN_SENDS', '')).toLowerCase() !== 'true') return [];

return [{
  json: {
    ok: true,
    sql: CLAIM_SQL,
    query_params: [null, new Date().toISOString(), null, false, false],
    scheduled_poll: true,
  },
}];

const SETTLE_SQL = "WITH requested AS (
  SELECT
    $1::uuid AS dispatch_id,
    $2::uuid AS lease_token,
    nullif(lower(btrim($3::text)), '') AS simulate_http_status,
    coalesce($4::boolean, false) AS respond_to_webhook
), simulated_outcome AS (
  SELECT
    requested.*,
    CASE
      WHEN simulate_http_status ~ '^[1-5][0-9][0-9]$' THEN simulate_http_status::integer
      ELSE NULL
    END AS http_status,
    simulate_http_status = 'network' AS network_failure
  FROM requested
), outcome AS (
  SELECT
    simulated_outcome.*,
    simulate_http_status IS NULL
      OR coalesce(http_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299, false) AS succeeded,
    network_failure
      OR http_status = 429
      OR coalesce(http_status BETWEEN 500 AND 599, false) AS transient_failure
  FROM simulated_outcome
), dispatch_scope AS (
  SELECT dispatch.*
    FROM renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatches dispatch
    JOIN requested ON requested.dispatch_id = dispatch.id
   WHERE dispatch.status = 'running'
     AND dispatch.lease_token = requested.lease_token
     AND dispatch.lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp()
   FOR UPDATE OF dispatch
), item_decisions AS (
  SELECT
    item.id,
    item.campaign_target_id,
    item.template_name,
    CASE
      WHEN account.id IS NULL OR vehicle.id IS NULL
        OR account.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR vehicle.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT'
      WHEN account.campaign_paused OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM renovation_dev.conversations conversation
         WHERE conversation.customer_id = account.id
           AND conversation.status IN ('handed_off', 'closed', 'renewed', 'not_interested')
      ) THEN 'CAMPAIGN_PAUSED'
      WHEN account.opportunity_closed OR vehicle.opportunity_closed THEN 'OPPORTUNITY_CLOSED'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS guard_rejection
  FROM renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items item
  JOIN dispatch_scope dispatch ON dispatch.id = item.dispatch_id
  LEFT JOIN renovation_dev.campaign_targets target ON target.id = item.campaign_target_id
  LEFT JOIN renovation_dev.quicklink_account_assignments account ON account.id = target.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN renovation_dev.quicklink_vehicle_assignments vehicle ON vehicle.id = target.vehicle_id
  WHERE item.status = 'pending'
), counts_before AS (
  SELECT
    count(*)::integer AS pending_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE guard_rejection IS NULL)::integer AS eligible_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE guard_rejection IS NOT NULL)::integer AS guarded_count
  FROM item_decisions
), existing_failures AS (
  SELECT count(*)::integer AS failed_count
    FROM renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items item
    JOIN dispatch_scope dispatch ON dispatch.id = item.dispatch_id
   WHERE item.status = 'failed'
), settlement_plan AS (
  SELECT
    dispatch.*,
    outcome.http_status,
    outcome.network_failure,
    outcome.succeeded,
    outcome.transient_failure,
    counts_before.pending_count,
    counts_before.eligible_count,
    counts_before.guarded_count,
    existing_failures.failed_count AS existing_failed_count,
    outcome.transient_failure
      AND dispatch.worker_attempt_count < 4
      AND counts_before.eligible_count > 0 AS should_retry,
    CASE dispatch.worker_attempt_count
      WHEN 1 THEN 30
      WHEN 2 THEN 120
      WHEN 3 THEN 300
      ELSE NULL
    END AS retry_delay_seconds
  FROM dispatch_scope dispatch, outcome, counts_before, existing_failures
), guarded_items AS (
  UPDATE renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items item
     SET status = 'failed'::renovation_dev.delivery_status,
         reject_reason = decision.guard_rejection,
         last_error = lower(decision.guard_rejection),
         attempt_count = least((SELECT worker_attempt_count FROM settlement_plan), 3)
    FROM item_decisions decision
   WHERE item.id = decision.id
     AND decision.guard_rejection IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING item.id
), sent_items AS (
  UPDATE renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items item
     SET status = 'sent'::renovation_dev.delivery_status,
         attempt_count = least(plan.worker_attempt_count, 3),
         sent_at = now(),
         provider_message_id = coalesce(item.provider_message_id, 'dryrun-' || item.id::text),
         last_error = NULL,
         metadata = item.metadata || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
           'dryRun', true,
           'sentBy', 'REN-DEV-WF-02B',
           'simulateHttpStatus', plan.http_status
         ))
    FROM item_decisions decision, settlement_plan plan
   WHERE item.id = decision.id
     AND decision.guard_rejection IS NULL
     AND plan.succeeded
  RETURNING item.*
), provider_failed_items AS (
  UPDATE renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items item
     SET status = 'failed'::renovation_dev.delivery_status,
         attempt_count = least(plan.worker_attempt_count, 3),
         reject_reason = 'SEND_FAILED',
         last_error = CASE
           WHEN plan.network_failure THEN 'simulated_network_failure'
           ELSE 'simulated_http_' || plan.http_status::text
         END,
         metadata = item.metadata || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
           'dryRun', true,
           'sentBy', 'REN-DEV-WF-02B',
           'simulateHttpStatus', plan.http_status,
           'simulateNetworkFailure', plan.network_failure
         ))
    FROM item_decisions decision, settlement_plan plan
   WHERE item.id = decision.id
     AND decision.guard_rejection IS NULL
     AND NOT plan.succeeded
     AND NOT plan.should_retry
  RETURNING item.id
), updated_targets AS (
  UPDATE renovation_dev.campaign_targets target
     SET send_count = target.send_count + 1,
         last_template_sent = item.template_name,
         last_sent_at = item.sent_at
    FROM sent_items item
   WHERE target.id = item.campaign_target_id
  RETURNING target.id
), finalized AS (
  UPDATE renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatches dispatch
     SET status = CASE
           WHEN plan.should_retry THEN 'queued'::renovation_dev.dispatch_status
           WHEN NOT plan.succeeded AND plan.eligible_count > 0 THEN 'failed'::renovation_dev.dispatch_status
           WHEN dispatch.rejected_count > 0
             OR plan.guarded_count > 0
             OR plan.existing_failed_count > 0
             THEN 'partial'::renovation_dev.dispatch_status
           ELSE 'completed'::renovation_dev.dispatch_status
         END,
         process_after = CASE
           WHEN plan.should_retry THEN now() + make_interval(secs => plan.retry_delay_seconds)
           ELSE dispatch.process_after
         END,
         next_attempt_at = CASE
           WHEN plan.should_retry THEN now() + make_interval(secs => plan.retry_delay_seconds)
           ELSE NULL
         END,
         completed_at = CASE WHEN plan.should_retry THEN NULL ELSE now() END,
         lease_token = NULL,
         leased_at = NULL,
         lease_expires_at = NULL,
         last_http_status = plan.http_status,
         last_error = CASE
           WHEN plan.should_retry AND plan.network_failure THEN 'simulated_network_failure'
           WHEN plan.should_retry THEN 'simulated_http_' || plan.http_status::text
           WHEN NOT plan.succeeded AND plan.network_failure THEN 'simulated_network_failure_retries_exhausted'
           WHEN NOT plan.succeeded AND plan.transient_failure THEN 'simulated_http_' || plan.http_status::text || '_retries_exhausted'
           WHEN NOT plan.succeeded THEN 'simulated_http_' || plan.http_status::text || '_terminal'
           ELSE NULL
         END
    FROM settlement_plan plan
   WHERE dispatch.id = plan.id
  RETURNING dispatch.*, plan.succeeded, plan.transient_failure, plan.should_retry,
            plan.pending_count, plan.eligible_count, plan.guarded_count,
            plan.existing_failed_count, plan.network_failure
), selected_dispatch AS (
  SELECT dispatch.*
    FROM renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatches dispatch, requested
   WHERE dispatch.id = requested.dispatch_id
)
SELECT
  selected_dispatch.id::text AS job_id,
  selected_dispatch.sf_dispatch_id,
  (finalized.id IS NOT NULL) AS claimed,
  (finalized.id IS NOT NULL) AS settled,
  true AS allowed_to_send,
  CASE
    WHEN finalized.id IS NULL THEN 'lease_lost'
    WHEN finalized.should_retry THEN 'retry_scheduled'
    WHEN finalized.succeeded THEN 'success'
    WHEN finalized.transient_failure THEN 'retries_exhausted'
    ELSE 'terminal_failure'
  END AS outcome,
  coalesce(finalized.status, selected_dispatch.status)::text AS dispatch_status,
  coalesce(finalized.worker_attempt_count, selected_dispatch.worker_attempt_count) AS attempt_count,
  coalesce(finalized.process_after, selected_dispatch.process_after) AS process_after,
  finalized.next_attempt_at,
  finalized.last_http_status,
  requested.simulate_http_status,
  requested.respond_to_webhook,
  'dry_run'::text AS send_mode,
  coalesce((SELECT count(*)::integer FROM sent_items), 0) AS sent_count,
  coalesce(
    CASE WHEN finalized.should_retry THEN finalized.eligible_count ELSE 0 END,
    (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items item
      WHERE item.dispatch_id = selected_dispatch.id AND item.status = 'pending'),
    0
  ) AS pending_count,
  coalesce(finalized.existing_failed_count, 0)
    + coalesce((SELECT count(*)::integer FROM guarded_items), 0)
    + coalesce((SELECT count(*)::integer FROM provider_failed_items), 0) AS failed_count
FROM requested
LEFT JOIN selected_dispatch ON true
LEFT JOIN finalized ON finalized.id = selected_dispatch.id;
";
const claim = $input.first().json ?? {};

if (!claim.job_id || !claim.lease_token) {
  throw new Error('A claimed dispatch must include job_id and lease_token.');
}

return [{
  json: {
    sql: SETTLE_SQL,
    query_params: [claim.job_id, claim.lease_token, claim.simulate_http_status || null, claim.respond_to_webhook === true || claim.respond_to_webhook === 't' || claim.respond_to_webhook === 'true'],
  },
}];

const PREPARE_REAL_SQL = "WITH requested AS (
  SELECT
    $1::uuid AS dispatch_id,
    $2::uuid AS lease_token,
    coalesce($3::boolean, false) AS respond_to_webhook,
    coalesce($4::timestamptz, clock_timestamp()) AS guard_at
), dispatch_scope AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT dispatch.*
    FROM renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatches dispatch
    JOIN requested ON requested.dispatch_id = dispatch.id
   WHERE dispatch.status = 'running'
     AND dispatch.lease_token = requested.lease_token
     AND dispatch.lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp()
   FOR UPDATE OF dispatch
), item_counts AS (
  SELECT
    count(item.id)::integer AS total_count,
    count(item.id) FILTER (WHERE item.status = 'pending')::integer AS pending_count
    FROM dispatch_scope dispatch
    LEFT JOIN renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items item
      ON item.dispatch_id = dispatch.id
), candidate AS (
  SELECT
    item.id AS item_id,
    item.campaign_target_id,
    item.template_name,
    item.metadata,
    account.id AS customer_id,
    account.salesforce_contact_id AS sf_account_id,
    account.phone AS current_phone,
    account.campaign_paused,
    account.opportunity_closed AS account_opportunity_closed,
    account.deleted_at AS account_deleted_at,
    vehicle.id AS vehicle_id,
    vehicle.service_name,
    vehicle.salesforce_opportunity_id,
    vehicle.opportunity_closed AS vehicle_opportunity_closed,
    vehicle.deleted_at AS vehicle_deleted_at,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM renovation_dev.conversations conversation
       WHERE conversation.customer_id = account.id
         AND conversation.status IN ('handed_off', 'closed', 'renewed', 'not_interested')
    ) AS conversation_blocked
  FROM dispatch_scope dispatch
  JOIN renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items item
    ON item.dispatch_id = dispatch.id
   AND item.status = 'pending'
  LEFT JOIN renovation_dev.campaign_targets target ON target.id = item.campaign_target_id
  LEFT JOIN renovation_dev.quicklink_account_assignments account ON account.id = target.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN renovation_dev.quicklink_vehicle_assignments vehicle
    ON vehicle.id = target.vehicle_id
   AND vehicle.customer_id = account.id
  ORDER BY item.id
  LIMIT 1
), decision AS (
  SELECT
    requested.dispatch_id,
    requested.lease_token,
    requested.respond_to_webhook,
    dispatch.id AS scoped_dispatch_id,
    dispatch.sf_dispatch_id,
    dispatch.worker_attempt_count,
    coalesce(item_counts.total_count, 0) AS total_count,
    coalesce(item_counts.pending_count, 0) AS pending_count,
    candidate.*,
    CASE
      WHEN dispatch.id IS NULL THEN 'LEASE_LOST'
      WHEN coalesce(item_counts.total_count, 0) <> 1 THEN 'REAL_BATCH_LIMIT'
      WHEN coalesce(item_counts.pending_count, 0) <> 1 THEN 'NO_PENDING_ITEM'
      WHEN NOT renovation_dev.is_automatic_send_allowed(requested.guard_at) THEN 'OUTSIDE_BUSINESS_HOURS'
      WHEN candidate.customer_id IS NULL OR candidate.vehicle_id IS NULL
        OR candidate.account_deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR candidate.vehicle_deleted_at IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT'
      WHEN candidate.campaign_paused OR candidate.conversation_blocked THEN 'CAMPAIGN_PAUSED'
      WHEN candidate.account_opportunity_closed OR candidate.vehicle_opportunity_closed THEN 'OPPORTUNITY_CLOSED'
      -- Catálogo del documento de escenarios §6; mismo conjunto que
      -- `begin_real_hsm.sql`. Ver la nota allí sobre por qué este guard importa
      -- mientras ninguna de las tres esté APPROVED en Meta.
      WHEN candidate.template_name NOT IN (
             'renovacion_vencimiento_2026_v1',
             'renovacion_vencimiento_2026_v2',
             'renovacion_vencimiento_2026_v3'
           ) THEN 'INVALID_TEMPLATE'
      WHEN candidate.current_phone !~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$'
        OR candidate.metadata->>'phone' IS DISTINCT FROM candidate.current_phone
        THEN 'INVALID_PHONE'
      WHEN coalesce(candidate.salesforce_opportunity_id, '') !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{15,18}$'
        THEN 'OPPORTUNITY_REVALIDATION_UNAVAILABLE'
      WHEN candidate.metadata->>'realSendState' = 'requesting'
        AND candidate.metadata->>'realSendMessageId' IS NULL
        THEN 'PROVIDER_RESULT_UNKNOWN'
      WHEN btrim(coalesce(candidate.metadata->'mergeFields'->>'1', '')) = ''
        OR btrim(coalesce(candidate.metadata->'mergeFields'->>'3', '')) = ''
        OR btrim(coalesce(candidate.service_name, '')) = ''
        THEN 'MISSING_TEMPLATE_VARIABLE'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS guard_outcome
  FROM requested
  LEFT JOIN dispatch_scope dispatch ON true
  LEFT JOIN item_counts ON true
  LEFT JOIN candidate ON true
), extended_lease AS (
  UPDATE renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatches dispatch
     SET lease_expires_at = clock_timestamp() + interval '120 seconds'
    FROM decision
   WHERE dispatch.id = decision.scoped_dispatch_id
     AND decision.guard_outcome IS NULL
  RETURNING dispatch.id
)
SELECT
  decision.dispatch_id::text AS job_id,
  decision.sf_dispatch_id,
  decision.lease_token::text,
  decision.item_id::text,
  decision.respond_to_webhook,
  decision.worker_attempt_count AS attempt_count,
  decision.total_count,
  decision.pending_count,
  decision.guard_outcome AS real_outcome,
  decision.guard_outcome IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM extended_lease) AS should_revalidate_salesforce,
  decision.salesforce_opportunity_id,
  decision.sf_account_id,
  decision.template_name,
  decision.metadata->'mergeFields' AS merge_fields,
  decision.service_name,
  decision.current_phone AS phone
FROM decision;
";
const claim = $input.first().json ?? {};
if (!claim.job_id || !claim.lease_token || claim.send_mode !== 'real') {
  throw new Error('A real HSM claim must include job_id, lease_token and send_mode=real.');
}
return [{ json: {
  sql: PREPARE_REAL_SQL,
  query_params: [
    claim.job_id,
    claim.lease_token,
    claim.respond_to_webhook === true || claim.respond_to_webhook === 't' || claim.respond_to_webhook === 'true',
    new Date().toISOString(),
  ],
} }];

const BEGIN_REAL_SQL = "WITH requested AS (
  SELECT
    $1::uuid AS dispatch_id,
    $2::uuid AS lease_token,
    $3::uuid AS item_id,
    coalesce($4::boolean, false) AS respond_to_webhook,
    nullif(btrim($5::text), '') AS expected_opportunity_id,
    coalesce($6::timestamptz, clock_timestamp()) AS guard_at
), item_scope AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    dispatch.id AS scoped_dispatch_id,
    dispatch.sf_dispatch_id,
    dispatch.worker_attempt_count,
    item.id AS scoped_item_id,
    item.template_name,
    item.metadata,
    account.id AS customer_id,
    account.phone AS current_phone,
    account.campaign_paused,
    account.opportunity_closed AS account_opportunity_closed,
    account.deleted_at AS account_deleted_at,
    vehicle.id AS vehicle_id,
    vehicle.service_name,
    vehicle.salesforce_opportunity_id,
    vehicle.opportunity_closed AS vehicle_opportunity_closed,
    vehicle.deleted_at AS vehicle_deleted_at,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM renovation_dev.conversations conversation
       WHERE conversation.customer_id = account.id
         AND conversation.status IN ('handed_off', 'closed', 'renewed', 'not_interested')
    ) AS conversation_blocked
  FROM requested
  JOIN renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatches dispatch
    ON dispatch.id = requested.dispatch_id
   AND dispatch.status = 'running'
   AND dispatch.lease_token = requested.lease_token
   AND dispatch.lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp()
  JOIN renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items item
    ON item.id = requested.item_id
   AND item.dispatch_id = dispatch.id
   AND item.status = 'pending'
  LEFT JOIN renovation_dev.campaign_targets target ON target.id = item.campaign_target_id
  LEFT JOIN renovation_dev.quicklink_account_assignments account ON account.id = target.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN renovation_dev.quicklink_vehicle_assignments vehicle
    ON vehicle.id = target.vehicle_id
   AND vehicle.customer_id = account.id
  FOR UPDATE OF dispatch, item
), decision AS (
  SELECT
    requested.dispatch_id,
    requested.lease_token,
    requested.item_id,
    requested.respond_to_webhook,
    requested.expected_opportunity_id,
    scope.scoped_dispatch_id,
    scope.sf_dispatch_id,
    scope.worker_attempt_count,
    scope.scoped_item_id,
    scope.template_name,
    scope.metadata,
    scope.service_name,
    scope.current_phone,
    CASE
      WHEN scope.scoped_dispatch_id IS NULL THEN 'LEASE_LOST'
      WHEN NOT renovation_dev.is_automatic_send_allowed(requested.guard_at) THEN 'OUTSIDE_BUSINESS_HOURS'
      WHEN scope.customer_id IS NULL OR scope.vehicle_id IS NULL
        OR scope.account_deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR scope.vehicle_deleted_at IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT'
      WHEN scope.campaign_paused OR scope.conversation_blocked THEN 'CAMPAIGN_PAUSED'
      WHEN scope.account_opportunity_closed OR scope.vehicle_opportunity_closed THEN 'OPPORTUNITY_CLOSED'
      WHEN scope.salesforce_opportunity_id IS DISTINCT FROM requested.expected_opportunity_id
        THEN 'OPPORTUNITY_CHANGED'
      -- Catálogo del documento de escenarios §6. La ruta real quedó migrada a
      -- estas plantillas el 2026-08-14; las tres son de vencimiento, que es la
      -- única familia que el sender real envía hoy. Ninguna está APPROVED
      -- todavía en Meta, así que este guard sigue siendo el que impide enviar
      -- una plantilla que Meta rechazaría.
      WHEN scope.template_name NOT IN (
             'renovacion_vencimiento_2026_v1',
             'renovacion_vencimiento_2026_v2',
             'renovacion_vencimiento_2026_v3'
           ) THEN 'INVALID_TEMPLATE'
      WHEN scope.current_phone !~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$'
        OR scope.metadata->>'phone' IS DISTINCT FROM scope.current_phone
        THEN 'INVALID_PHONE'
      WHEN scope.metadata->>'realSendState' = 'requesting' THEN 'PROVIDER_RESULT_UNKNOWN'
      WHEN btrim(coalesce(scope.metadata->'mergeFields'->>'1', '')) = ''
        OR btrim(coalesce(scope.metadata->'mergeFields'->>'3', '')) = ''
        OR btrim(coalesce(scope.service_name, '')) = ''
        THEN 'MISSING_TEMPLATE_VARIABLE'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS guard_outcome
  FROM requested
  LEFT JOIN item_scope scope ON true
), marked AS (
  UPDATE renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items item
     SET attempt_count = least(decision.worker_attempt_count, 3),
         metadata = item.metadata || jsonb_build_object(
           'realSendMode', 'real',
           'realSendState', 'requesting',
           'realSendStartedAt', to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"')
         ),
         updated_at = now()
    FROM decision
   WHERE item.id = decision.scoped_item_id
     AND decision.guard_outcome IS NULL
  RETURNING item.id
), extended_lease AS (
  UPDATE renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatches dispatch
     SET lease_expires_at = clock_timestamp() + interval '120 seconds'
    FROM decision
   WHERE dispatch.id = decision.scoped_dispatch_id
     AND decision.guard_outcome IS NULL
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marked)
  RETURNING dispatch.id
)
SELECT
  decision.dispatch_id::text AS job_id,
  decision.sf_dispatch_id,
  decision.lease_token::text,
  decision.item_id::text,
  decision.respond_to_webhook,
  decision.worker_attempt_count AS attempt_count,
  decision.guard_outcome AS real_outcome,
  decision.guard_outcome IS NULL
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marked)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM extended_lease) AS should_call_meta,
  decision.expected_opportunity_id AS salesforce_opportunity_id,
  decision.template_name,
  decision.metadata->'mergeFields' AS merge_fields,
  decision.service_name,
  decision.current_phone AS phone,
  'real'::text AS send_mode
FROM decision;
";
const item = $input.first().json ?? {};
if (!item.job_id || !item.lease_token || !item.item_id || item.real_outcome !== 'SF_OPEN') {
  throw new Error('Salesforce must confirm one open Opportunity before the final local guard.');
}
return [{ json: {
  sql: BEGIN_REAL_SQL,
  query_params: [
    item.job_id,
    item.lease_token,
    item.item_id,
    item.respond_to_webhook === true || item.respond_to_webhook === 't' || item.respond_to_webhook === 'true',
    item.salesforce_opportunity_id,
    new Date().toISOString(),
  ],
} }];

const SETTLE_REAL_SQL = "WITH requested AS (
  SELECT
    $1::uuid AS dispatch_id,
    $2::uuid AS lease_token,
    $3::uuid AS item_id,
    upper(btrim($4::text)) AS real_outcome,
    $5::integer AS http_status,
    nullif(btrim($6::text), '') AS provider_message_id,
    nullif(left(btrim($7::text), 500), '') AS error_message,
    coalesce($8::boolean, false) AS respond_to_webhook
), dispatch_scope AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    dispatch.id AS scoped_dispatch_id,
    dispatch.sf_dispatch_id,
    dispatch.worker_attempt_count,
    dispatch.rejected_count
  FROM renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatches dispatch
  JOIN requested ON requested.dispatch_id = dispatch.id
  WHERE dispatch.status = 'running'
    AND dispatch.lease_token = requested.lease_token
  FOR UPDATE OF dispatch
), plan AS (
  SELECT
    requested.dispatch_id,
    requested.item_id,
    requested.real_outcome,
    requested.http_status,
    requested.provider_message_id,
    requested.error_message,
    requested.respond_to_webhook,
    scope.scoped_dispatch_id,
    scope.sf_dispatch_id,
    scope.worker_attempt_count,
    scope.rejected_count,
    requested.real_outcome = 'META_ACCEPTED'
      AND requested.http_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299
      AND requested.provider_message_id ~ '^wamid\.' AS provider_accepted,
    requested.real_outcome IN ('SF_TRANSIENT', 'META_TRANSIENT', 'OUTSIDE_BUSINESS_HOURS')
      AND scope.worker_attempt_count < 4 AS should_retry,
    CASE scope.worker_attempt_count
      WHEN 1 THEN 30 WHEN 2 THEN 120 WHEN 3 THEN 300 ELSE NULL
    END AS retry_delay_seconds
  FROM requested
  JOIN dispatch_scope scope ON true
), counts_before AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE item.status = 'accepted')::integer AS accepted_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE item.status = 'pending')::integer AS pending_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE item.status = 'failed')::integer AS failed_count
  FROM renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items item
  JOIN plan ON plan.scoped_dispatch_id = item.dispatch_id
), accepted_item AS (
  UPDATE renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items item
     SET status = 'accepted'::renovation_dev.delivery_status,
         provider_message_id = plan.provider_message_id,
         attempt_count = least(plan.worker_attempt_count, 3),
         sent_at = now(),
         reject_reason = NULL,
         last_error = NULL,
         metadata = item.metadata || jsonb_build_object(
           'realSendMode', 'real',
           'realSendState', 'accepted',
           'realSendMessageId', plan.provider_message_id,
           'realSendHttpStatus', plan.http_status,
           'sentBy', 'REN-DEV-WF-02B'
         ),
         updated_at = now()
    FROM plan
   WHERE item.id = plan.item_id
     AND item.dispatch_id = plan.scoped_dispatch_id
     AND item.status = 'pending'
     AND plan.provider_accepted
  RETURNING item.campaign_target_id, item.template_name, item.sent_at
), retry_item AS (
  UPDATE renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items item
     SET metadata = (item.metadata - 'realSendState' - 'realSendStartedAt') || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
           'realSendMode', 'real',
           'realSendHttpStatus', plan.http_status,
           'realSendLastOutcome', plan.real_outcome
         )),
         last_error = lower(plan.real_outcome),
         updated_at = now()
    FROM plan
   WHERE item.id = plan.item_id
     AND item.dispatch_id = plan.scoped_dispatch_id
     AND item.status = 'pending'
     AND plan.should_retry
  RETURNING item.id
), failed_items AS (
  UPDATE renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items item
     SET status = 'failed'::renovation_dev.delivery_status,
         attempt_count = least(plan.worker_attempt_count, 3),
         -- `reject_reason` solo admite el vocabulario cerrado que fija el CHECK
         -- de V12. Los motivos internos del guard real —INVALID_TEMPLATE,
         -- MISSING_TEMPLATE_VARIABLE, PROVIDER_RESULT_UNKNOWN— no están en esa
         -- lista y caen a SEND_FAILED; su causa exacta sobrevive en
         -- `last_error`. Mapear INVALID_TEMPLATE de forma literal violaba el
         -- CHECK y abortaba el settlement entero, dejando el item sin liquidar.
         reject_reason = CASE plan.real_outcome
           WHEN 'CAMPAIGN_PAUSED' THEN 'CAMPAIGN_PAUSED'
           WHEN 'OPPORTUNITY_CLOSED' THEN 'OPPORTUNITY_CLOSED'
           WHEN 'INVALID_PHONE' THEN 'INVALID_PHONE'
           WHEN 'UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT' THEN 'UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT'
           WHEN 'OUTSIDE_BUSINESS_HOURS' THEN 'OUTSIDE_BUSINESS_HOURS'
           ELSE 'SEND_FAILED'
         END,
         last_error = lower(coalesce(plan.real_outcome, 'real_send_failed')),
         metadata = item.metadata || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
           'realSendMode', 'real',
           'realSendState', 'failed',
           'realSendHttpStatus', plan.http_status,
           'realSendLastOutcome', plan.real_outcome
         )),
         updated_at = now()
    FROM plan
   WHERE item.dispatch_id = plan.scoped_dispatch_id
     AND item.status = 'pending'
     AND NOT plan.provider_accepted
     AND NOT plan.should_retry
     AND (item.id = plan.item_id OR plan.item_id IS NULL OR plan.real_outcome = 'REAL_BATCH_LIMIT')
  RETURNING item.id
), updated_target AS (
  UPDATE renovation_dev.campaign_targets target
     SET send_count = target.send_count + 1,
         last_template_sent = accepted.template_name,
         last_sent_at = accepted.sent_at
    FROM accepted_item accepted
   WHERE target.id = accepted.campaign_target_id
  RETURNING target.id
), result_counts AS (
  SELECT
    counts.accepted_count + (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM accepted_item) AS accepted_count,
    counts.pending_count
      - (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM accepted_item)
      - (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM failed_items) AS pending_count,
    counts.failed_count + (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM failed_items) AS failed_count
  FROM counts_before counts
), finalized AS (
  UPDATE renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatches dispatch
     SET status = CASE
           WHEN plan.should_retry THEN 'queued'::renovation_dev.dispatch_status
           WHEN counts.accepted_count > 0 AND (plan.rejected_count > 0 OR counts.failed_count > 0)
             THEN 'partial'::renovation_dev.dispatch_status
           WHEN counts.accepted_count > 0 THEN 'completed'::renovation_dev.dispatch_status
           ELSE 'failed'::renovation_dev.dispatch_status
         END,
         process_after = CASE
           WHEN plan.should_retry THEN now() + make_interval(secs => plan.retry_delay_seconds)
           ELSE dispatch.process_after
         END,
         next_attempt_at = CASE
           WHEN plan.should_retry THEN now() + make_interval(secs => plan.retry_delay_seconds)
           ELSE NULL
         END,
         completed_at = CASE WHEN plan.should_retry THEN NULL ELSE now() END,
         lease_token = NULL,
         leased_at = NULL,
         lease_expires_at = NULL,
         last_http_status = plan.http_status,
         last_error = CASE
           WHEN plan.provider_accepted THEN NULL
           WHEN plan.should_retry THEN lower(plan.real_outcome)
           ELSE lower(coalesce(plan.real_outcome, 'real_send_failed'))
         END
    FROM plan, result_counts counts
   WHERE dispatch.id = plan.scoped_dispatch_id
  RETURNING
    dispatch.id AS finalized_dispatch_id,
    dispatch.sf_dispatch_id,
    dispatch.status AS finalized_status,
    dispatch.worker_attempt_count,
    dispatch.process_after,
    dispatch.next_attempt_at,
    dispatch.last_http_status,
    plan.real_outcome,
    plan.provider_accepted,
    plan.should_retry,
    plan.respond_to_webhook,
    counts.accepted_count AS real_accepted_count,
    counts.pending_count AS real_pending_count,
    counts.failed_count AS real_failed_count
), audit AS (
  INSERT INTO renovation_dev.interaction_logs (
    event_type, correlation_id, payload, success, error_message
  )
  SELECT
    'wf02b_real_hsm',
    finalized.sf_dispatch_id || ':' || coalesce(requested.item_id::text, 'batch'),
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'sf_dispatchId', finalized.sf_dispatch_id,
      'item_id', requested.item_id,
      'outcome', finalized.real_outcome,
      'http_status', requested.http_status,
      'provider_message_id', requested.provider_message_id,
      'attempt', finalized.worker_attempt_count
    )),
    finalized.provider_accepted,
    CASE
      WHEN finalized.provider_accepted THEN NULL
      ELSE coalesce(requested.error_message, lower(finalized.real_outcome))
    END
  FROM finalized, requested
  RETURNING id
), selected_dispatch AS (
  SELECT
    dispatch.id,
    dispatch.sf_dispatch_id,
    dispatch.status,
    dispatch.worker_attempt_count,
    dispatch.process_after,
    dispatch.next_attempt_at,
    dispatch.last_http_status
  FROM renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatches dispatch, requested
  WHERE dispatch.id = requested.dispatch_id
)
SELECT
  selected.id::text AS job_id,
  selected.sf_dispatch_id,
  (finalized.finalized_dispatch_id IS NOT NULL) AS claimed,
  (finalized.finalized_dispatch_id IS NOT NULL) AS settled,
  coalesce(finalized.provider_accepted, false) AS allowed_to_send,
  coalesce(finalized.real_outcome, requested.real_outcome, 'LEASE_LOST') AS outcome,
  coalesce(finalized.finalized_status, selected.status)::text AS dispatch_status,
  coalesce(finalized.worker_attempt_count, selected.worker_attempt_count, 0) AS attempt_count,
  coalesce(finalized.process_after, selected.process_after) AS process_after,
  coalesce(finalized.next_attempt_at, selected.next_attempt_at) AS next_attempt_at,
  coalesce(finalized.last_http_status, selected.last_http_status) AS last_http_status,
  requested.respond_to_webhook,
  coalesce(finalized.real_accepted_count, 0) AS sent_count,
  coalesce(finalized.real_pending_count, 0) AS pending_count,
  coalesce(finalized.real_failed_count, 0) AS failed_count,
  'real'::text AS send_mode
FROM requested
LEFT JOIN selected_dispatch selected ON true
LEFT JOIN finalized ON finalized.finalized_dispatch_id = selected.id;
";
const item = $input.first().json ?? {};
if (!item.job_id || !item.lease_token) {
  throw new Error('A real HSM settlement must include job_id and lease_token.');
}
const rawStatus = item.real_http_status;
const httpStatus = rawStatus === null || rawStatus === undefined || rawStatus === '' ? null : Number(rawStatus);
return [{ json: {
  sql: SETTLE_REAL_SQL,
  query_params: [
    item.job_id,
    item.lease_token,
    item.item_id || null,
    String(item.real_outcome || 'PROVIDER_RESULT_UNKNOWN'),
    Number.isInteger(httpStatus) && httpStatus > 0 ? httpStatus : null,
    item.provider_message_id || null,
    item.real_error || null,
    item.respond_to_webhook === true || item.respond_to_webhook === 't' || item.respond_to_webhook === 'true',
  ],
} }];

## WF-02B - Durable Campaign Batch Sender

Dry-run remains the default behind `RENOV_DEV_DRY_RUN_SENDS=true`. Real HSM is an explicit one-item pilot requiring `send_mode=real`, `job_id`, `RENOV_DEV_REAL_HSM_ENABLED=true`, an allowlisted phone, an open Salesforce Opportunity linked to the same Account and a final local guard.

The 5-second poll never claims work already marked for real send. Meta network, 5xx and 2xx-without-`wamid` ambiguity are terminal because Meta provides no idempotency key for this POST. Retry delays remain 30/120/300 seconds for Salesforce and known Meta transient failures such as 429.

SQL sources: `dispatch/{claim_dispatch,sender_dry_run,prepare_real_hsm,begin_real_hsm,settle_real_hsm}.sql`.
